review_text:
Pros
- The material is thicker, which I liked because it did not wrinkle as much 
- Lovely pale yellow color
-Good length!

Cons
- It does run a little small. I normally wear a 4/6, and the 6 fit just fine. 
- The neck hole is quite small!

I wore this dress to my boyfriend's Air Force pilot training graduation and wing pinning. I comfortably wore this dress for 7 hours. The top was a little big on me but I am small in the chest area. I wore a bra and it helped a lot. I got a long size and the length was perfect for me. The overall fit was very nice. I am definitely going to be renting a dress form RTR again.

I absolutely love this dress! I rented it for an industry night and it was so flattering to my curvy figure! I typically wear a 12 or a 14 and the 12 was a bit snug on me. If you're a larger chested gal like myself with a curvy figure I would get the 14 rather as it seems to run a little small. I got so many compliments, I didn't mind that it was a little snug! Love this dress and would absolutely rent it again!

Since almost all of the reviews mention that this is oversized (it's supposed to be), I sized down to a Small (it fits great). Since I'm tall and not a twig, oversized clothing just makes me look huge. This blazer is heavy, but beautiful and textured. It's swanky--kind of like a smoking jacket.
Nothing NOT to love about this dress. The pattern is beautiful and the material very soft.  At 5'2" it hit me right at the knee.  The dress has a lot of give so you can size down.

Unfortunately didn't get to wear the dress as the birthday brunch I bought it for was cancelled but I wore it around the house for fun.  The small fit perfectly but I've left off one star for the length as it was just a little too long for my 5'2", even with 4" wedges.  Still though, the dress is very pretty, light and airy and the slit makes it easier to walk around in with the length.  I would definitely rent this again!

I was not sold on this dress at all until the day of the Ball when I put on my strapless bra, did my hair and make-up, put on my jewelry and then slipped into the dress. When I saw myself in the mirror I was really shocked at how gorgeous it all came together. The dress crosses in the back which made the sides pucker but with the right bra it was not a problem. Getting in a out of it was a little difficult so I had to put a bonnet on so I didn't mess up my hair or make-up. Overall I had an amazing night in this beautiful dress and I loved the pockets. My only issue was the zipper was a little iffy.
The small fit better around the shoulders and bust. However, the slip on the small was very tight and didn't allow much movement, so I wore the medium.

Super stylish and classy. 
I only wish they rented the size 10 and 12 in long so I could have worn heels with it.
This combo piece can be worn separately, and is super comfortable. Only downside was that it ran super big. Will get a smaller size next time for sure.

I was surprised at how much I loved this dress. It was actually a backup style to a Lilly I ordered but I liked this one better. Very cute, loose, and perfect for a casual summer dress. I wish I didn't have to send it back!
great length for work, runs a little small.  I got a size up and it was still tight in the bust, but I have a larger chest.
The asymmetry of the dress was fun. It does run a bit small, though the material has some give. It was a bit short for a wedding.
Wore this for a fundraiser that was Gatsby themed. Went with the larger size, since it was a work function. Very comfortable!

My grandmother was a style icon in many ways-- a sassy Southern belle with a huge and amazing closet. I got this dress to wear to her funeral where I was the main speaker. I felt like it hit the right note. Conservative enough to still be appropriate for a somber occasion, but stylish enough that I felt like I was honoring her memory. Like other reviewers, I found it to be formfitting, however, I disagree with the idea you can't wear it with Spanx! (I did and it looked GREAT and very flattering.)  I would say this is a very versatile dress-- you could wear it to a conservative work function or glam it up with accessories for a cocktail party or a night out. If I had this in my closet, it would get a lot of wear for sure.

I wore this dress to a Fall wedding.  I was comfortable all evening and felt very elegant wearing this dress.   I ended up sizing up to the 8 as this dress did run small.   I also had a slight issue with getting the zipper to catch but after messing with it a bit I was able to get the dress zipped up all the way.  Overall a great rental and would definitely rent this one again!

I ended up not wearing it only because the group and outings were super casual and it actually got pretty cold.  I did not have the right tops to layer and make it look nice without being either overdressed or freezing.  Other than that, I loved it.  The item itself was great.  My timing for the rental was just way off.  :(

I'm tall and have long arms and legs. It was a little too short in the arms for me and a little tight on the shoulders. That said, most dresses and shirts are like this on me because despite having a small frame, I have broader shoulders. I wouldn't say it's true to size. A 4 was between a 2 and a 4 for a shift dress. Cute pattern. Fabric didn't feel completely premium.
Fit a little loose in the bust, but was able to make up for that with a strapless bra. Could have been worn without a bra. The dress is gorgeous, I received several compliments.
Just a little to lose to be great. I'm pretty much between a 6 and 8, so going to try the 6 in this brand next time.
DVF is always a good choice. This was the perfect work dress, hit right above the knee and is so flattering.  The fabric is light, and the dress would probably work well for any season or event.

I was so scared it was not going to fit due to the reviews but I actual went with the XS. Thank goodness we get two sizes. The material is a little heavy but covers any bumps from bra straps or underwear lines. I wore it backwards like the reviews suggested and it made it more appropriate for my age. Sexy but cute and perfect for my engagement party! Wish it came in other colors!
This is a crop top! Cute sweater and definitely dazzles but hard to wear a crop top sweater.

As others have said, this dress is low cut but if you have some double-sided fashion tape, it feels just fine and looks pretty amazing! I normally wear a 2-4.... could have gone with the 2 but went with the 0 (I had switched that to be my backup size after reading the reviews that it ran large). I wore it to a black tie optional event and loved it. The dress was definitely well-worn; had a tiny hole on the inside of the pocket and I had to snip some frayed edges on the skirt and steam it... but it was worth it!
These fit true to size. They have no stretch though.

True to size, the slit in the front was a nice sexy feature, it was not too high showed off the leg. I kept the jewelry simple wore a choker from Rent the Runway. I am 5'3" a quick hem allowed me to walk without holding up the dress.
I usually wear an XS but the small was a much better fit. Stretchy and form fitting.  Wore it under an RTR blazer and it was the perfect birthday outfit for work.

Lots of compliments! I enjoyed wearing this jumpsuit and felt very chic at the theater. It was a little big for my taste. The straps were a little long and the fabric is very thick/heavy so the outfit was heavy on my shoulders. Maybe a smaller size would have fit a bit better. I did not wear a bra with this outfit. I am 5'9" and the pant legs were plenty long enough for me to wear heels.
This dress was a perfect fit. The flowers and bell sleeves made the look extra special. Loved it!

I absolutely loved this dress! It runs a bit big (I'd recommend going down a size if you want a tighter fit or going with your true size for a looser fit.) The color is absolutely stunning. I got so many compliments on it all night! I would completely recommend this dress for any holiday event!

I said I wanted to channel my inner Solange and this dress got me there. All the bridesmaids wore a palate of neutrals and golds so the pale pink was perfect. I received the dress in perfect condition (didn't have to steam like some other reviewers mentioned). I'm 5'7 1/2" and the 4L was long enough to skim the ground in 3 inch heels. Size wise, I could've made the 2L work but the 4 was better for length and dancing all night. Just wore a seamless bandeau to keep the nipple situation in check. The cape is longer than the dress so I carried it like a train when I had to walk outside. I got a TON of compliments  - the cape and cut make the whole look statuesque. I won the esteemed and very made up Best Dressed award - I don't know if pictures do this dress justice! Overall, could not recommend this ond more. I always use RTR for wedding and events since I travel/move a lot but I wish I could've kept this gown forever! NOTE: remember to tuck and tape the hanger strings! I forgot ugh

I absolutely love this jacket! It was light enough for everyday wear, but warm enough for chilly nights. I'm still debating on buying this one. Might rent again and keep it. It's great for a dressed up look as well as for a casual weekend!

This dress was PERFECT for the black tie wedding I attended this fall! From the sequins to the gather in the front, I felt like a movie star and I received numerous compliments from the other wedding guests, which was an added perk! I was worried that the W size would be too wide around my chest and not hold me in, but it worked out just fine. The length was perfect, as well, and I wore flats. Word to the wise: be sure to either pin or adjust the back of your bra so that it doesn't peek up in the back above the zipper! Also, as many other reviewers have commented, this dress is best if you're ready and willing to be pretty exposed in the front! For accessories, I wore some cluster earrings, and that was it! Let the dress do all the talking ;) I'll definitely use RTR in the future for other fancy events!
This dress was so pretty on! I loved wearing it and would have bought it if I could afford it.

I wore this dress to my birthday brunch in NYC. It is fun and very girly. My husband said the colors reminded him of Christmas lights which I thought was great! As with other Badgley Mischka's that I have rented, I found that it ran just a little small. I mostly noticed it in the arms. Unfortunately, they did not have my backup size available, but I was able to make my size work. I loved it and would definitely recommend! Lots of compliments.
beautiful pattern. thick top. pretty skirt. runs large and was unflattering

This dress is phenomenal. It hugged every curve but the double layers and pattern made it very forgiving. I loved that it was a turtleneck as the fuller coverage paired well with how form-fitting it was. I wore this dress on a date and then for New Year's Eve party. I honestly don't want to return it but (as with most items on RTR) the buy it price is more than I want to spend on one dress. Be selective with pairing jewelry and purses as the outer layer of this dress is a delicate woven fabric that can snag if you're not careful. Otherwise, the dress is amazing and I can see it looking great on a lot of different body types. If you're new the RTR or struggle with finding your right size in other dresses, this is a great dress to try.

I typically wear a 12/14 on top and a 14/16 on bottom, but only received the 16 of this dress, as a backup for one I chose that was unavailable. It was beautifully cut and very comfortable, but the top ran extremely large. I can imagine it would be great for those with a larger chest, but I had to safety pin the sides in about 2 inches on either side. In the end, it worked well and was super fun to dance in. Would recommend to those whose bust/hip measurements are more proportionate than mine!

This dress was absolutely stunning. It was really well made, you can wear a regular bra and it can be dressed up for a black tie affair or dressed down for a more casual event. I ordered an 8L and a 10R because the long was not available. I ultimately think a 12L would have been the perfect fit. I am 5'10" and the Regular was too short (although I'm not sure too many people actually noticed). The dress also ran tight around the bottom. I was perfectly comfortable in the top but the skirt zipped tight and a little more wiggle room would have been appreciated! Overall I would rent this again but size up! I paired this dress with the Nocturne Purple Ari Necklace for a fun pop of color!

Didn’t end up wearing it ; for a smaller chested girl, the straps were way too long. Didn’t want to spend the time or hassle to safety pin when my backup dress was perfect. 
The chest and straps were long but the dress length was great (I am 5’2) with tall 4”heels

Loved this top. Super simple but cute. It runs a bit large, even with larger busts. It's also really long, so make sure that's the look you're going for. I paired with jeans and wedges to dress down. You can also dress up very easily to wear to work. Super light and perfect for summer weather.
trouble with the arms but worked it out
fit was a dream, pockets were a plus and the skirt detail was a show stopper

As others mentioned, this dress is roomy. I wore size 12. I'm usually a 14 for designer labels such as these. The dress was fun & bright. It doesn't have much shape to it, which can be good or bad, depending on what you're looking for. If you are a curvier woman such as myself, this dress style ends up looking like a bag on you. But damn, that bag is comfortable! The fabric was well made, not thin but not too thick either. I wore a strapless bra & normal underwear. Huzzah! I would definitely recommend if you want a comfortable party dress.

I wore this jacket for a couple of outings that required another layer in chilly dining rooms. It was the perfect weight and warmth. The fit was true to size and the color was soft but eye catching. It looked like a simple addition of layers in a very stylish way.

I love the color and dramatic back of this dress. It was a bit big in the chest, but I was also very self conscious about that area due to my malfunctioning adhesive backless bra cups (maybe i ordered the wrong size cups? won't be using them again). It's a lovely thick fabric and I found the dress to be flattering and elegant with a twist. I wore 4 inch heels and the dress length was perfect. But once I started dancing I ditched the heels and had to hold my dress up to avoid stepping on it. A satin sash in the same color would've been a nice addition to the waist line. I would still order this again!
Beautiful versatile lace dress.  I wore this to work but could definitely dress up for any occasion.

I ordered the 6 and ended up wearing the backup size 8 just to be more comfortable throughout the entire ceremony. It was longer than I had anticipated. It hit me just above the knee. I wore spanx underneath and you couldn't see the outline. The material is thick enough to hide that. But would totally order and wear over and over again.
I usually wear a size 6, but my hips are larger and the 6 was too snug.  I wore my backup size, an 8.  Lots of room up top for a larger bust.  The length was perfect.

This is my first time renting a dress. I have had a great experience. I went ups this morning and mailed it back. Thank you rent the runway!! I will definitely do this again.  I would recommend this company. I would definitely go up.on your size.

I was glad I ordered 2 sizes because I usually wear a size 12 and the 10 I got was too big. It was big up top and the straps kept falling down. I have bigger thighs and hips and the dress made me look wider than I am. It was a pretty dress, but I would suggest going down a couple sizes because this dress made me feel very bulky.

This dress was super flattering! I did have to size up, for reference I have recently worn size 2 in Nicole Miller, Halston Heritage, Slate & Willow and they all fit perfectly. Had to size up only due to the bust and butt. I think if you were smaller in those areas you would be fine with the 2. Overall loved this dress - just wish for these longer length dresses they had petite lengths as it was longer than I would have liked!

I ordered a size 2 and 4. At home I only tried on the 4, and it fit, but I decided to bring the 2 with me just in case. I tried on the 2 at the hotel and realized it actually fit better. The major difference was that the bust was tighter, which I actually preferred because I was not wearing a bra. The 2 was also slightly longer for some reason, which was perfect for my shoes. Added bonus...it was very comfortable for dancing! I would definitely recommend.

This dress is absolutely stunning! I received a lot of compliments on the color. I think I could have gone a size done because the bust area was a little loose. However, it still looked great. It is best to wear a strapless bra of course. I recommend this dress for a summer wedding!

Is true to size, but super long! I wore the 4, with a regular (low-front) bra, and was super comfortable all night. Only problem is that the dress is super long, even with 5 inch wedges I was still stepping on the hem.

I wore this for a dinner out with my boyfriend.  I have a large chest/wide rib cage and it fit fine. I was easily able to use some tape to keep everything in place.  It was a little short waisted on me (and I think I have a average length torso), but it wasn't noticeable or uncomfortable.   I thought the unlined back, nude lining, and deep plunge V-neck added some sex appeal while keeping it classy.  I rented the medium and the large (normally an 8 or 10 in dresses) and I wore the medium.

I got this as a free backup since I was a first time renter, and I didn't end up wearing it. The pattern of the dress was really cute and the cut was comfortable, but the heavy fabric made it more of a work dress than a party dress.
It is a stunner! So happy with it, just hard to walk in because of the bottom, would size up next time.

I fell in love with the photos and thought this would be perfect for the fall. I ordered a small and tried it on. Unfortunately, it looked way big on me. I am also 5'1. I wanted a nice loose comfy sweater/jacket but this one didn't suit my frame.  I was so sad to return it. This would be suitable for a taller person.

These ran large and i wish i had gotten a smaller size BUT i still wore them a few times and loved them.  i dressed them up for work with a structured peplum shirt and dressed them down with a tshirt for everyday.

wow, got compliments all night. busty ladies may need to pass unless you're comfy with serious cleavage. the dress fell down a bit and I had to continually lift it up, or would give 5 stars. This dress is 10/10 classy and 10/10 sexy
This is a great sort of dressed up grunge vibe and I lived in this comfy shirt/jacket for a weekend. That said, it does run large, so if you're a very petite woman, it might not be the best fit.
I didn't wear this unfortunately, the sleeves were way too long
The dress fit great and showed off my shape.  I wore if for a bridal shower and I loved.
True to size - perfect fit. I was able to wear a small heel for the length. The slit up the side was an added bonus and made the dress that much more appealing! I would definitely recommend it!
The large was just a tad too big... A medium would have been more flattering and less baggy, but still loved it!

Before renting I read that the dress ran small in fit and length.  I upped my normal 4/6 order to 6L/8L and ended up wearing the 8L.  I am 5'7'' and wore 2.5in heels.   It fit like a glove, was a perfect length and I got many compliments. The material is pretty heavy which surprised me when I got the dress, but it looks beautiful on. My only complaints are the slit is a bit short so it was hard to walk with my normal stride- felt a little restrictive and near the armpits did not lay nicely, there was a little gap there. Otherwise it was a great choice for a beautiful wedding at the Rainbow Room!
I am petite and the dress ran a bit large on the top portion of the dress specifically. Otherwise, this dress was extremely comfortable and something I would definitely wear again.
The pattern is quite true to photo. It was a bit on the revealing side, so I wore a bandeau over the top of my strapless as well. It was light weight and fun and flirty.

I'm usually a size 0-2, but had to wear the 4 as this dress has NO give. Unfortunately,  the dress was thus a little big in the chest area, but not so much so that it looked bad. As a result, I wouldn't recommend this dress for more curvy girls since there isn't any stretch and the dress can be a little restricting to move in. Overall, very happy with this purchase! Loved it!

The color on this dress is it's best feature -- bright, flamingo pink. Almost day-glo. The styling is just okay, and it runs VERY large. I'm a solid 8 and I think the 4 would've been the best fit for me, though the 6 worked. The dress is a polyester crepe material, and unlined (which is a mistake for this fabric). The neckline and cold shoulders add a bit of visual interest, but otherwise the styling is not super flattering or even fun -- it's a bit too long for anyone under 5'8" and too full. There was also some weird pleating in the back that made the rear look unflattering. Overall, I would not strongly recommend for women with curves or petites.
Definitely needs a cami or something underneath, as neckline of the large is quite low. Has pockets!
Great top for work or a meeting! Simple yet has some flare to it from the draping. This style runs true to size and I suggest sizing up for a back up.

I rented this as a cover-up for a vacation and it was perfect. It would have been too short to wear as an everyday outfit. The material was perfect for hot weather. The off the shoulder stayed up and wasn't too tight. The only reason I say it runs small is that the shorts are SHORT.

The most versatile skirt that I can't wait to work into my fall wardrobe! This skirt is perfect to dress up or down since you can definitely wear a t-shirt or a blouse to dress it up. It does run a bit small so I would recommend sizing up. It is fitted at the hips so I would likely size up the next size for backup so that I can have some room to tuck in a blouse! The fabric has no stretch and the skirt comes up about 3-4 inches from the knee. I don't want to give this skirt back!
A little big, I could have gone down a size. Length was great with high heels (I am short)

It was skintight, flashy, revealing on both the top and bottom. Great for grabbing attention. It does run a little large, you want to wear this skin tight with a pair of skinny heels to get the best effect :)
My little beef is that it was super worn in. For $30 I can't complain too much, but I ordered the medium and the large as a backup and the medium was so much more worn that it was a different color; the sequins were more copper instead of gold. The large was in much better shape, the sequins were bent, and missing in certain areas on the medium. But like I said, for $30, it was totally wearable and I got plenty of compliments (and comments, who says you can't wear a mini after 30!)

Loved the material and overall design.  Wore a large and way too big, but made it work.  Arm cutout was a little big so not as flattering as other cold shoulder tops I have worn.  Color is exactly as shown, brownish-olive.  I would wear again but would size down.
I'm a 2 in normal everyday clothing. Went with a 4. Dress is comfortable but tight.

I wore this as my back up wedding dress. It is elegant and classy, I was told at one point, I had the best dress at the wedding! The peekaboo back adds a nice touch. I paired it with tan shoes. Easy to dance in, very comfortable. For reference, I am 5'4, 130 lb, B cup and the dress fit perfectly. Thanks rent the runway for another great outfit!

I loved the edgy/different look of the high neck and low back paired with the flowing skirt. It was the only dress like it at the wedding and I received so many compliments on it throughout the night. I was surprised at how tight the slip under the skirt was in comparison to the general loose look of the dress. I would definitely order a size up just in case because the waistband and the slip does not have any give.
Fits well!

This dress runs a bit large so it was a little big around the hips. I would say I am average around the hip area and typically don't have an issue with this. The fabric was sleek and very nice. As mentioned, the color was great. It's not as red as it appears in the pictures. It's a little more maroon. Overall, great dress!

I'm typically a 0R but, this dress ran small in the chest. I'm also a 32A and it was tight! My build is athletic and fit comfortably in the 2R. I'm 5'0 tall and had to wear 5 inch heels (the dress still dragged a little)! Overall, gorgeous dress and received compliments all evening :) I will say, I thought it was impossible to wear undergarments with the dress because you could see everything! Flaunt what your mama gave you honey!
great dress, lots of compliments. Definitely runs small so I recommend ordering the size up from your usual
Love this dress. Added to my list to rent again.

Recommend going one size down...don't want this dress falling off!  I am large on top, but going down one size was not an issue.   Stayed in place all night.  Very flattering dress on athletic and curvy girls.

The slit is pretty high but the long piece of the dress offsets it in a sexy, yet classy way. I have a curvy body so I would 100% suggest a size up for those who are the same (normally 8, wore 10). Overall fun dress!

I rented this as my back up dress for a semi formal gala. I love this designer and the dress is beautiful. I did find the fabric didn't have much give, especially the sleeves. I also found the neck somewhat constricting. Might try a size larger if I order it as a back up next time? Something to keep in mind: there's no zipper in the back or anything and the neck is tight, so it kind of messes with your make up and hair when you put it on. Unless maybe you put the dress on first and wear a sheet over it while you do your make up. I ended up wearing the other dress I rented because it was more comfortable.

Wore this as a bridesmaid dress at 20 weeks pregnant. The top part was tight, while the rest was flowy to accommodate my modest bump. Most people couldn't even tell I was pregnant in this one. Bra was built in and material was of good quality. Excellent pick!
Gorgeous! The detail was amazing.

I loved the curvy shape of this photo, but if you bulge anywhere, this dress will reveal it. I ordered 1 size up, and should have ordered 2 sizes up.  The fabric is a tight, stretchy, non-breathable material that feels like neoprene (scuba material). Very sexy, but only appropriate if you have an awesome figure.
Both sizes fit great, but went with the smaller one for a more snug fit. Color was beautiful and the length was perfect for a girl of my height.

I was so glad that I read the previous reviews, as I would have never ordered at size 4, but that was perfect.  The six would have been WAY too big.  The straps are rather long on this dress so I had to pin them.  Wish they had adjustable straps.  Other than that it was a beautiful and comfortable dress with pockets!!!
Loved this dress!  I wore it to a carnival on the 4th of July with my kids.  It was lightweight and easy for a hot day.

very boxy/ runs very large-- I ordered the small and wear a 34C / size 4 or 6 usually for tops and the small looked ridiculous on me. Would have been cute in the XS. Very thick fabric/ good for winter.

I received a lot of compliments on this dress. The bright color and simple silhouette made the dress incredibly flattering. I am pictured in the 4, but ended up wearing the 6. With the 4 I would not have been able to wear a bra, eat, or move freely. The 6 fit more comfortably, and was still flattering.
This dress is marvelous! A little tight in the sleeves as others have said.....but what a knock-out! I received countless compliments.

Dress fit well, did not need to wear a bra and coverage was good.   Right shoulder sleeve required some adjustments for winter jacket, dancing and such but was not a significant issue.   Received many compliment on this dress!!

Got lots of compliments on this dress! Very ladylike and perfect for the bridal shower I wore it to. you can tell the dress is well made. The skirt was a little fuller than I was expecting but I loved the pockets! I did have to adjust the top a bit throughout the shower to ensure there were no slips.

This dress fit great! I was able to wear a normal, racer-back bra with it (which is a pre-qualifier for me) and the pockets really came in handy! The length was perfect for my 5'3" frame and hid my tummy area which I'm a little self-conscious of since having a baby. The only reason I took away one start is because the chest area was slightly big for me, but the waist was a perfect fit. If I'd had more time I would have pinned it so it didn't gap under the arms. Still, I got many complements and felt great in the dress.
Y'all. This dress was amazing! It was super flowy but not sheer or loose. I wish I could wear it everyday!

Fit true to size and hit just above the floor in flats.  I wore it with strapless spanx, otherwise I am sure it would have been very comfortable. Perfect pick for my event, very happy overall with the dress.
Fabulous fit, especially for petite ladies.  +1 On the other posters, wear black tights and pair with some black boots or booties and it's a very chic, tailored look with a touch of edge.

Wore this dress to a casual, mid-summer wedding. It was the perfect length and style for the crowd of mostly family with a few friends--young and stylish without showing too much skin. Still though, those laser cutouts on the chest go pretty deep and pretty wide, so there's potential for quite a bit of peek-a-boo cleavage (lucky for me, I'm not chesty). Also, the neoprene fabric shows every dimple and fold, which made underwear selection an absolute nightmare.

Fit me snug but not uncomfortably at high waist. I'm only 5 feet tall so these grazed the very back of my 4" heels almost to the floor. I sized up one size from my usual size 6. Beautiful  fabric. the pale stripe is almost but not quite silvery in color not white.

It was even better in person!  I rented the same dress just in a pattern, this one was a tad tighter than the other but it was fine.  I didn't need to wear a bra and still felt comfortable enough to have a great time.  The color is phenomenal.  Everyone at the formal event was in blank or navy, and I felt red hot in this!  If you want to feel like the life of the party rent this!!
Lots of compliments.  Slightly large on top - had to keep pulling up when dancing.  Overall, great dress.

I wanted a dress for my bday where we celebrated in a swanky rooftop and this dress was perfec for the occasion! I'm usually a size 4 or a XS/S but in this dress, I had to go with a M. This dress doesn't have as much stretch as I thought it would and so the S didn't fit on my bottom. The neckline is much deeper than shown in the pic (I ran to pin it). I'm a 32DDD and didn't need the girls to be completely out. It's a beautiful dress. I didn't wear any spanx underneath and I received so many compliments all night! I would definitely recommend this one!

I range from a 0-4 depending on the designer and while I could have squeezed into the small I didn't like it enough to bother with it. It was cute but just not cute enough to be worth wearing a tightish skirt with no give on a night that I was going to be eating a lot of food. As a side note mine came with the belt but it was in a separate pouch which I think not all of the reviewers noticed in their shipment.

It was an overall great dress. I wore it to my Company's Holiday party. Formal affair. Cons about it is I like to dance and it is very hard to lift your arms high to swing dance. Other than that, great dress, material quality seemed nice, and color was nice.

This dress was much lighter than I thought it would be. I fit the 14 perfectly, but the zipper on the dress wouldn't stay up so I ended up in the 16 for the night. It ended up being ok as I was 3 months pregnant and appreciated the extra room. It was fun to dance in and move around. It held its shape very well. 
Overall, I liked the dress, but it wasn't the showstopper I was hoping for. I felt pretty, but not sexy or over the top.

These pants are super cute but run large. I typically wear a 0-2 or a 25/26 in pants and these were too large for me to wear. Tried to tie super tight, but definitely not able to wear as they were visibly much too large.  Size down!
Was too short for work so sadly didn't wear, but beautiful construction and gorgeous fabric. Will order again and size up.

This dress definitely runs small- I'm normally a 4-6 and the 8 was tight in the middle and big in the shoulders. The design is really pretty. Maybe would look better on someone who has a straighter figure. I'm 5'4, 125, 34D and size 27 in jeans.
The dress is a little roomy for small chested women, so sizing down (or wearing a padded backless bra) is probably a good idea.
i thought it was a cute top, the color is very vibrant.  ran a tad large so I was able to wear the 8 instead of a 10.  loved it.

I got compliments on this dress all night. It was so comfortable and hugged in all the right places. I am a size 30G and didn’t have to wear a bra which was a huge bonus. I wore 3 inch heels and the length was perfect. I have no complaints about this dress other than that I had to return it!
This is such a cute top!! Flattering fit and comfortable.
I didn't need to wear a bra with this, which I loved. People were chasing me down all night to compliment the dress so I think it was a hit. I definitely recommend it!
I rented this dress for a work even and recieved many compliments. It's simple yet elegant and so comfortable. Will definitely rent again in the future! Thanks RTR!!!
Wore the 0R. Was a little tighter at the top than expected. Wore it with alot of gold jewelry.
Very pretty, classy dress. Pretty heavy though and slightly itchy fabric. I'm very busty and could wear it without a bra (bc of open back). I usually wear a 16w or so and the 20w fit perfectly.
Great flow to hide those trouble areas!
I fell in love with this dress. Wore it to a formal college dinner. Everything about it was just amazing: color, style, fabric, the ruffles. Highly recommend this dress.

I love this sweater! Its unique and also very comfortable. This runs true to size and is great for any cup size. It is loose and there is comfortable room throughout the midsection. This may be worn with a standard bra. The fabric does have some stretch! Pair this with statement earrings and jeans!
Love this shirt and I want to buy it! Cute and comfortable with a great style. :)

This dress is flattering, adorable, and it was perfect for my work convention!  I got TONS of compliments!  Even though it was a little on the short side, it showed just enough leg to be flirty without being inappropriate.  I wish I could buy this dress!

Dress runs big but rhinestone belt has no give so sizing down would have just made it to tight around my ribs. I have a small chest and tried to wear a backless stick on bra which was a fail. The cut was too low and would show the bra which made it uncomfortable to dance in. Ended up using a safety pin to not show the bra. Sleeves were also too long. Would not recommend this dress for a petite person.

It was the perfect dress for my party! I received lots of compliments, and I felt completely comfortable in it the whole night.  It does run a little small, but it had stretch in all the right places, so I felt like going a little more snug was the way to go. I have a small chest, and this is one of few times the dress contoured even me! I highly recommend this dress for a multitude of events.

I wore this dress for a black tie charity event I attended.  The dress was beautiful and I receive a ton of compliments.  The quality of the dress was high.  The embroidery was beautiful and the straps and waist are velvet material.  A few notes:  Although the description says you can wear this without a bra, if you are a c-cup or larger, I would recommend wearing a strapless bra with this dress - otherwise the top of the dress will start to sag (this happened to me) and leave some gaps in your chest and stomach area.  I ended up having to wear a strapless bra with it.  Also - because of the embroidery and lace material, the dress is very hard to zip up.  I live by myself and it took me a solid 15 minutes or so to get the dress zipped because of the material which kept snagging.  I am 5'6" and could only wear 2" heels or else the dress would have been too short.  Otherwise, I would rent this dress again!

Loved the fit and style of this dress. Runs long.  It was preeeetty snug around my waist, but there was no way I could've sized up because the skirt would've been dragging on the group.  Perfect for a contemporary museum day.

I ordered this for New Years Eve for an event that I went to at Top Golf. I am glad I ordered the medium for a back up. This shirt does not have any give and will be very tight in the bust if you are larger. I usually am a size small in tops but due to the lack of give and my larger bust size, the medium fit well.

The color is more of a brown that a copper than I thought it was going to be, but still very pretty top.

Sadly, the top wasn't seen much as the temperature outside was way below 0.

Got the XLR. I am a curvy size 12 and could not zip this up past my butt crack.  The pants are very, very high waisted with no give as these are a crepe like material.  XLR fits more like a smaller size 10.  Pants were unique and very cool looking and wish they would have fit.  I am 5'8" and would have needed to wear heels in order for the long side not to hit the floor.  These pants are for those with a small waist.
I wore it with a nude heel and simple jewelry. The dress speaks for itself!

I loved this dress and got compliments all night long. I got it in long and it still came up shorter than I'd hoped. I could see my toes when barefoot (I'm 5'9) and with my shoes (only 1.5 in) on you could see my feet. It also wasn't as forgiving as I'd hoped as far as hiding any lumps and bumps. It was very comfortable and my arms didn't even get irritated from the sequins. With all that being said, I still loved it!

Very unique pants! I wore a size 2 ( I am typically a 0) and they were tight in the thigh and hip area.  However, above the hips, as you can see, there was too much space and it looked baggy.  If you are hippy, I suggest sizing up for sure.  I did like the design at the bottom of the pants, however.  Overall, I like the pants and would rent them again, even though it did not exactly work out how I wanted it to for my body type.  I am skinny, but have an hourglass shape.

This dress is stunning, the photos really do not do it justice. It simply looks amazing in person, I received so many complements when I wore it to a black tie wedding. It really is a showstopper, the color is fabulous, and the style is so fashionable. I have  slim body type, so  I will say it was slightly large in the hips for me, even in a 0. Still wore it, though, and it still looked amazing. I have nothing to say except good things about this dress.

Cons: the straps were worn and slightly torn. 
Pros: still wearable and a fun summer top.

This dress was  A showstopper. I got compliments on it all night long. I did feel really great in it except the top was too big for me. So I was constantly having to pull it up which was kind of annoying. Looking back I wish I would have rented a size two.

Blouse is beautiful u wore it twice, twice forgot to take pick. The blouse is big, the look calls for it but I think a size down would have looked better. The tassels on the sleeves are an issue but I fixed it by hiding them inside the sleeves. Lots of cleavage, so beware if that's an issue for you. A cute bra or tank helps.
a bit too low cut and a bit snug for a medium.  usually her designs in medium fit me perfectly.
I loved everything about this dress. From the color, to the lace, to the fit- I couldn't have asked for a better dress, and I received so many compliments on it.

Shape: Since the dress snugs against my figure, I wore body shaper to have every flabby tucked in. 
Material: There's a little stretch so that made room while sitting. It's lined inside so there's a little weight to the dress that helps sustain its shape and remain wrinkle-free throughout the wedding reception. 
Length: I'm glad that I had ordered the petite because the dressed dropped near my toes with 3-inch heels. Did not drag on the dance floor at all. 
Color: The blue is as you see it online. The downside of this beautiful blue is that the bride's second reception dress happened to be the same color and similar cut  *( 0_o)  I tried, I seriously tried not to match the bridal party.
I mostly like it, but it looked kind of weird since it's quite boxy. And tight fitting

I absolutely LOVED this dress. When I ordered it, I was concerned about the low cut. However, given my bust size, the dress fit comfortably and was not too revealing. It was the perfect dress to wear to a wedding! My only complaint is the stiffness of the zipper. You’ll definitely need a second pair of hands.

I'm absolutely in love with this gem of a dress and never wanted to give it back! It fit like a glove and was so incredibly comfortable. The material is stretchy, but not too loose. I'm 5'8" and love to eat ALL of the snacks. So, I have more to love in my mid-section, but the material was thick and stretchy enough I didn't have to squeeze into Spanx. I wore 2-3 inch heels, which worked perfectly with the 42 L. The dress hit before the end of the heels, so no tripping potential. That was a major plus because I'm clumsy as can be! :) I'm not busty at all, but the dress was still flattering with the fun cut-outs. The bright pink color was too much fun, and it even worked well with me being pale and too lazy to get a spray tan. I wore this to cover the CMA Awards in Nashville. You know you're doing something right if country superstars and darlings like CAM compliment your style! Don't worry, I quickly informed her it was all thanks to Rent the Runway! Can't thank y'all enough! Such a fantastic night! :)

I wore this as part of a Halloween costume. The dress was stretchy but the fabric wasn't too thin. It was a little big in the hips, but the weight of the fabric made it unnoticeable. The MR was LONG. I am 5'6" and I wore 3" inch heels and I stepped on it a few times.

I wore this to my Brother's wedding rehearsal and LOVED IT! It was super comfortable. It did run a tad bit large and was long, but I wore 4" wedges with it so it sat perfectly on the floor. Sorry, I do not have pictures :( The sleeves stayed put and I had plenty of room to eat and drink wine and didn't feel like it showed! I would rent this dress again! //  I am 5'4 and weigh around 140 lbs.

I ordered a much larger size for 35 week pregnancy bump. This made the top part just a little too large as the sleeves kept falling down. I probably should have used some fashion tape. Overall, I enjoyed this piece and received many compliments. It was a deeper red than I was expecting.
Wore this dress for a formal holiday party for work. Received numerous compliments - felt like the belle of the ball! Fit perfectly, length was appropriate even with flats. LOVE LOVE LOVE.
The lining of this dress was shorter than expected, especially when sitting down. It was a little less conservative than I anticipated for a professional event. Great color, a good holiday dress!

This dress was beautiful and classic, I received many compliments on it and it truly was appropriate for the occasion, a wedding.  One item to note however, is that the sequins were super uncomfortable and I had a rash under both arms by the end of the night.

I'm so glad I ordered one size up, otherwise this dress would have been too small. It was a good length on me, hitting me just above the knee. I wore tights under which helped to smooth out my shape, this dress isn't very forgiving in that department. Otherwise I did receive several compliments on this one.

The fit was a little big across the chest and shoulders (6P and 34A, 5'5" and 135 lbs) but was comfortable for my event. My daughter and I had fun trying on both sizes - petite was right for me, so I couldn't resist a photo with another customer at the event.
classy and sexy
Had to go up to the 8 because the smaller size fit better everywhere by my waistline.  The lace on the bodice was a little scratchy, but not too uncomfortable.  Great dress for  a winter wedding.
the only con is that the 2R was very long even with heels (I'm 5'4) so the train dragged a bit. pro: doesn't need a bra

Pros: It fit well so I didn't have to worry about something popping out
Cons: Hard to zip up because of the material
Great casual style. I have rented both the grey and the black and will rent them again.
I rented this and couldn't wear it.  It is HUGE.  It fit my husband and he's 6'1!  It's a beautiful coat though and I will try and order it again.  I'll probably go two sizes down though.

I wore this dress for my formal engagement photos and absolutely loved it! It was just the perfect amount of sparkle and was literally stopping traffic as we took our photos in a downtown area. It also photographed very well. It did run slightly large. I am typically a size 6, but wore a size 2.

Fit - I had to go up a size as my shoulders are pretty broad. This dress fit like a dream, coupled with some sculpting spanx it was a huge hit. It was truly comfortable to wear all evening. The only thing that was a bit off putting was the smell upon receipt, a little like old lady flowers. I was also worried that someone might have the same dress at the event I went to. It would be great if one could see how many dresses of the same style were in my zip code. Love you guys!

Received may compliments all night, I normally wear a medium but it was way too tight had to wear the large. I'm very short (5'0) so the legs rested pretty nice at the top of my heels. Great outfit wish I could keep it.

Rented this for a dressy casual wedding and it was perfect. The size 2 fit like a glove with a strapless bra. The cutout added just the right amount of edgy contrast with the floral pattern. Length fell just below my knees which was perfect for a windy outdoor venue.
I found it a bit snug in the chest area but other than that, it is fun summer top.

I really loved this dress!  I ordered the medium with a small as my backup.  I wore the medium but I should have worn the small - the back kept slipping down showing my strapless bra.  If you are in between sizes, I would recommend sizing down, especially if you have a smaller rib cage.

The side slits are indeed very high, so I wore it over top of a black dress. Unfortunately, I think that this sweater may have shrunk after cleaning as the bottom of the sweater didn't seem to hang or lay correctly (sort of longer on one side than the other, and definitely farther away from itself on the sides - front and back wise - than on the model). I did like the style, however, and it was thick and warm. It was a nice one-time everyday rental, but not a keeper.
I wore this for my birthday dinner and it was adorable. I got lots of complements from friends and strangers.

This was not a dress I originally ordered and was sent as a back up for an original selection that was out of stock. I was not terribly happy, TBH. But then I put this on, and wowza! First off, I am a 38DD and so wearing this without any support was not an option. After a couple of different tried I found that a tank top with a shelf bra provided just the right amount of coverage/support. The dress creates a fantastic silhouette without accentuating my particular problem area- my lower belly. I got so many compliments during the night, and my husband has suggested that I just buy this dress because I felt and looked so fantastic in it- and I might!

The opening for your legs at the bottom of the dress is pretty small so if you're looking to get down dancing I wouldn't suggest this dress.  You could also see every wrinkle of undergarments so had a hard time finding something that worked.  You could still wear a bra which was great.  The dress itself was a little beat up

So many complements! A really interesting and modern take on a maxi floral. The slits are the perfect height, and the silk is pinned to the slip underneath so that when you move or the wind blows, there is no risk of exposure. This dress was absolutely poetic for an outdoor event in the breeze, I felt like I was on a magazine photo shoot the entire time. Note that there is a hook and eye closure for the neckline- I missed that and let it gape scandalously for the first 2 hours I had it on. With that latched, the dress is a nice deep v but still perfectly appropriate. To be safe, I wore a v-neck black sports bra as a camisole over my bra. As most stated- the dress was fitted around the ribcage, and though slightly uncomfortable I would not have gone a size up despite being between an 8 and 10 dress size. I wore the 8 and just unzipped the top part to breathe a little whenever I had a denim jacket on over. Wore at least 5 times with unlimited, with heels to more formal events and sandals out and about.
It was too short if you want it to sweep the floor. Plus the dress I received was a bit tired sent it back without wearing.

never ordered dresses sized this way. wish I would have got it a size smaller. the stretch in the material would have been better tighter. but, it looked good...just could have been sexier. rented for Valentine's night date. fabric so comfy. MN winter and fabric was thick enough to be fine. don't know if I would have liked it in hot weather.
Slimming lines.

Because it doesn't stretch the chest was too tight for me. I ordered my normal size and a size down because other people said it ran big, but I couldn't take a full breath the whole night. I don't usually have problems fitting things on my chest so I was fairly surprised.  They didn't have a size up so I just wore it. Interestingly the size down fit just about the same.  It looked great though!

wore this to a charity cocktail hour. It was casual, so I added a black belt and black heels. Was a cute outfit but still not dressy enough for the occasion. more of a brunch, casual work dress. Not right for a night event.
It's a really huge jacket and thick.

The fit on this dress was a little small.  I wore an 8 and there was some room, but I did need to slide it up a bit to sit, but otherwise comfortable.  There is no stretch to the lace and the straps are adjustable.  It's a beautiful dress, great color, not too revealing but understated.  I see myself as "hippy" but these photos make me look more like a line backer.  I'm 5'9" 140lbs and I feel like the length probably wasn't my best choice.  Good news I have another event in December to rent for!

This dress definitely runs on the smaller side and shows off every curve--shapewear is your friend if you rent this dress! Weight was perfect for colder weather and the low back was a great detail, but definitely required a sticky bra or a backless bra converter if you need some extra support. The sequins were beautiful and I felt like a million bucks--I got compliments all night. I was sad to send this dress back--will definitely rent again!

I am normally a size 8 and based on the reviews I ordered a 4 and 6. I am giving this 2 stars because it is a beautiful dress and beautiful material, but it was completely unflattering on me. I was really looking forward to wearing this dress to my friend's wedding but it served my figure no justice. The pleating made me look extremely bottom heavy, which I think has to do with the material being so thick. I think it would have been a wonderful dress for a fall wedding and for dancing all night long, it just wasn't the right style for me.
It was a nice fitting comfortable dress.

This is a gorgeous dress. I had planned on wearing it a formal event and ordered the regular length based on previous reviews. Unfortunately even with over 4 inch heels, it was too long. My daughter (photographed with me) who is a little over 6 feet tall ended up wearing it. I think you have to be a supermodel to pull this length. I can't imagine how long the tall length runs. Maybe Usain Bolt could pull that off : ) That being said- it was so beautiful and she gots tons of compliments (she wore the regular length with flats).

For my job, I move a lot taking photos or producing video. I was able to move quickly to the floor to shoot photos and hop right back up to direct cameras without awkwardly fixing my clothes... which is saying a lot! This dress moved with me every step of the way. Would def rent again.
The dress fit well and the thick fabric makes this unique. Since the fabric is thick, it is quite warm so suggest renting this when the weather is cool.
I typically wear a size S in clothing and a 0 or 2 in dresses..the size S fit perfectly. Very low cut, but nothing a little fashion tape didn't help! Would highly recommend this dress.

Big fan of this dress! Wore it to a fall wedding and it was perfect. The dress was super comfy and also not too short and fit perfectly for someone who has a bigger chest. Definitely would recommend to someone in the future.
Fit was true to size. Loved it!!
even though the dress is fitted it's very flattering and forgiving in those areas that i'm not so comfortable with because of the material and the pattern.
Got many complements.  I wore it with tights and boats.  Very flattering fit.  Runs a bit large but still looked great.  I would consider buying this

I ordered XS and S for both my daughters. Although, they are both a size 0 in woman's, the XS was a little too tight around the torso. Definitely a size up needed. The small fit fine if you are a size 0.

Better for people with large chests (I am a D, and it was still a little roomy). 
Very classy, moves beautifully. It would have been a lot of fun to dance in. 
It is a long dress - ankle-length.

This dress is absolutely gorgeous in person with the lace and details. I would love to own it. I wore this for my bridal shower and received compliments all day long. My fiance loved it as well. It fit true to size and hugs curves in all the right places. Again, photos do not do it justice! Worth the rent! I got a 0 and size 2, and the size 2 was a little snug, but I loved it. A 4 would have been too big.
Very cute and flattering dress, a little tight on my legs when I sat down though.

This dress is VERY tight through the arms and shoulders. If you have any kind of muscle in that area I would recommend against it. I'm normally a 10, wore the 12 and felt like I was going to rip it the whole time. Couldn't sit down comfortably. It's also definitely not as long as the model makes it seem. I am about 5'11 and it came right beneath my knees.  Pretty but super uncomfortable.

Super fun and flowy cold shoulder top! This top may be dressed up or down and is perfect for everyday wear. There is no stretch to the fabric so I would size up for your backup. There is comfortable room in the bust and it is great for any cup size. A regular bra may be worn with this as well.
Fits true to size, maybe just slightly on the bigger side. I am 5'8'' and it was a good length. I would definitely recommend this piece.

The dress fit perfectly and I got many compliments at our rehearsal dinner.  The dress is beautiful in person and I would definitely recommend it!  The hem was a little undone on the one I rented, but unless I pointed it out I was the only one who noticed. It did not stop me from wearing the dress.
